AAD.caption: element_id
AAD.doc: The ID attribute of the Repeating Group or scrollable container that should receive drag-to-scroll behavior and the Kanban minimap navigation.
AAD.name: element_id

AAE.caption: hide_scrollbar
AAE.doc: Hides the native horizontal scrollbar while preserving all scrolling functionality, creating a cleaner Kanban board experience.
AAE.name: hide_scrollbar

AAG.caption: show_minimap
AAG.doc: Displays a floating Kanban minimap that provides an overview of all columns and indicates the currently visible area. Users can drag the highlighted area to navigate horizontally.
AAG.name: show_minimap

AAH.caption: minimap_color
AAH.doc: Defines the color of the minimap viewport indicator (the highlighted visible area). If left empty, the default color (#006CFF) will be used.
AAH.name: minimap_color
